regions.name: Davis & Yolo County, CA
regions.summary: Yolo County help and alerts, plus Davis city utility, billing and service contacts. Campus services are separate.
regions.scope: 211 and Alert Yolo cover Yolo County. City water, repair and billing numbers below apply to Davis city services, not every Yolo County address or UC Davis campus service.

contacts.title: Police, fire or medical emergency
contacts.detail: For an emergency, call 911. Phone service is needed; this file cannot contact responders.

contacts.title: Food, housing & community help
contacts.detail: Yolo County's information and referral line. Ask what local help fits your situation; an available place or benefit is not guaranteed.

contacts.title: Davis water leaks & sewer backups
contacts.detail: City Public Works: Monday–Friday, 7am–3:30pm, excluding holidays. The after-hours number is the City's police non-emergency line for these reports.

contacts.title: Davis city utility bills
contacts.detail: City water, sewer, waste and storm-drainage billing. Choose option 1 for billing questions. Check the provider named on your bill first.

contacts.title: Davis repairs & city services
contacts.detail: City general information can direct a non-emergency service question. For a private-property repair, use your property manager or a suitable specialist.

contacts.title: PG&E outage information
contacts.detail: For addresses served by PG&E. Other providers have their own reporting routes; confirm yours on the bill.

alert.name: Alert Yolo
alert.instruction: Before going offline, use the County's alert page to choose a signup method. Its SMS-only option is to text YOLO to 888777. Delivery needs mobile service and is not guaranteed.

regions.name: San Francisco, CA
regions.summary: City services, SFPUC billing, PG&E outage information and AlertSF. For San Francisco, not the whole Bay Area.
regions.scope: For the City and County of San Francisco. Utility contacts apply only to the provider on your bill; this is not a directory for the whole Bay Area.

contacts.title: Police, fire or medical emergency
contacts.detail: For an emergency, call 911. Phone service is needed; this file cannot contact responders.

contacts.title: City services, repairs & referrals
contacts.detail: Non-emergency City questions and service requests, including finding the right department for a local housing or administrative question.

contacts.title: SFPUC water & sewer service problems
contacts.detail: SFPUC directs water, power or sewer service problems to this 24-hour route. For immediate danger, call 911.

contacts.title: SFPUC water & sewer bills
contacts.detail: Ask about your bill or a payment plan. Available arrangements and eligibility depend on your account; this pack does not determine eligibility.

contacts.title: PG&E outage information
contacts.detail: For addresses served by PG&E. Other providers have their own reporting routes; confirm yours on the bill.

alert.name: AlertSF
alert.instruction: Before going offline, sign up for AlertSF using the City's instructions. Its SMS option is to text your ZIP code to 888777. Delivery needs mobile service and is not guaranteed.
